_README: eBay leaf category ids, keyed by '<gender>:<Shopify productType>', with
per-handle overrides for garments the key cannot separate.
eBay requires a LEAF category id on every listing. A wrong id either
rejects the row or files the garment somewhere no buyer looks, so every id
below was read off an eBay browse URL of the form
ebay.com/b/<name>/<ID>/ and none is guessed. scripts/ebay-listings.py
refuses to emit any row whose category is still null.
TO FILL A NULL: eBay Seller Hub -> Listings -> Create listing, search the
garment name, and take the id from the end of the resulting browse URL.
CORRECTION 2026-08-13: an earlier version of this file recorded 185082 as
a browse parent not to be listed into. That was wrong. 185082 is the leaf
for Women's Activewear Tops — eBay serves many marketing names off one id
(/b/Womens-Activewear-Tops/185082/ and
/b/Active-Athletic-Apparel-for-Women/185082/ are the same category), and a
different display name is not a different node. 185098 (Women's
Activewear) and 185099 (Men's Activewear) do look like parents of the
leaves used here, and are still avoided.
UNISEX: eBay has no unisex activewear leaf. Unisex garments are listed in
the men's leaf with the Department item specific set to 'Unisex Adult',
which is what that field is for and is standard practice — the category
describes the garment type, Department describes who it is cut for.
